args:
Follow instructions in ~/.agents/commands/to-execute-next-open-tactic.md to pick a tactic and complete its tasks exclusively within the Maintenance project of the Cartenario system (resolve it by name "Maintenance" within the Cartenario system via Ecelyo Satellite GET /systems; do not use Ecelyo App's Maintenance project ID 7052D534-0D70-45D1-BFB5-4A6C5B77E08D). Scope override for Cartenario (/Users/mhjaso/Developer/Projects/Cartenario) is authorized for this automation; do not select tactics from any other project or system.

Sort the tactics by version and always start with the lowest version (tactics use semver; if tactics have no version, fall back to priority). Then from the selected tactic pick the free task with the top priority.

Do not complete more than 2 tasks. Create one thread for each task if they are not related (do not reuse the same thread for unrelated tasks).
description: Every 6 hours (Europe/Madrid), picks a tactic from the Cartenario Maintenance project and completes up to 2 tasks.
